header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation received. The perusal of the
body: record shows that this petition was filed in the year 2016 and was lastly fixed on 05.04.2023, on which date also no one appeared on behalf of the petitioner. Even thereafter, no efforts were made by the petitioner to pursue this petition, which reflects that he is not interested in the same.
Under these circumstances, this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution. JUDGE JUDGE Salik
